sources.snippet: Code for the UniReps 2026 workshop extended abstract "Predicted Future Latents as Subgoals: Hierarchical Policies Outperform Flat Policies Beyond the Training Goal Distance" (Takahiro Morimoto, Miraiyochi, inc.). A goal-conditioned imitation policy is split into two levels that run inside one network, with no test-time search.

sources.title: Metro-WM: Long-Horizon Latent Planning with Realisable Sub-Goals
sources.snippet: Model-predictive control with Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provides a strong zero-shot goal-reaching planner, but it is only effective over short planning horizons. Hierarchical extensions attempt to bridge this gap by learning a macro planner to predict intermediate latent sub-goals to guide the micro planner.
